objectives: 學生可以學到VLSI測試及可測性之觀念，以幫助學生未來晶片設計之需求。
content:
1.Introduction
2.Fault Modeling
3.Testability Measures
4.Fault Simulation
5.Test Generation for Combinationa and Sequential Circuits
6.Design for Testability (DFT) and Built-In Self-Test (BIST)
7.Test Standards: IEEE 1149.1/1500/1687/1838
8.Memory Testing and Repair
books:
"Textbook:Bushnell and Agrawal ,""Essentials of Electronic Testing for Digital , Memory & Mixed-Signal VLSI Circuits"",Kluwer Academic Pubishers,2000
